titleStmt.title: Copy of a report of a committee of the honorable the privy council for Canada, approved by his excellency the governor-general, on the 16th day of November, 1880.

div.head: Copy of a report of a committee of the honorable the privy council for Canada, approved by his excellency the governor-general, on the 16th day of November, 1880.
div.p: The committee of council have had under consideration the dispatch of Sir E. Thornton, dated Washington, March 1, 1880, relative to the regulations for the transportation of merchandise to, from, and through the Dominion of Canada, and also the dispatch of Sir M. E. Hicks Beach, of the 31st March, No. 97, on the same subject.

The honorable the minister of customs, to whom the dispatches with the proposed regulations have been referred, reports that, having carefully considered said regulations, he is of opinion that they may be approved.
The committee recommend that the proposed regulations be approved accordingly.

closer.signed:
J. O. COTÉ,
Clerk Privy Council Canada.
